tei:div.tei:p: 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge'i gsung 'bum 'di ni/ ris med kyi rgyal bstan spyi la lhag bsam dang dag snang mnga' ba/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi mas bka' slob dang mdzub ston 'og/ lo ngo mang po'i ring ma dpe 'tshol bsdu dang legs sgrig byas pa brgyud da lan 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge'i gsung 'bum tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'grel pa rigs mdzod dang*/ rnam 'grel gyi bsdus don rigs pa'i sdom/ rigs gter gyi 'grel pa rigs pa grub pa bcas deb gsum du bgos nas mkhyen ldan gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du 'bul rgyu las/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang dpe rtags ( phyi zha 6 ) nang bzhugs tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi bsdus don rigs pa'i sdom dang*/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs dpe rtags ( phyi zha 32 ) nang bzhugs tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'grel pa grub mtha' sna tshogs kyi longs spyod kyis gtams pa'i rigs pa'i mdzod gnyis/ mes po'i shul bzhag ces pa'i dpe tshogs kyi khongs su spar bskrun zhus pa yin/ rnam 'grel gyi bsdus don rigs pa'i sdom 'di ni/ rigs mdzod kyi sa bcad dang rgyas bsdus mi mtshungs pas/ rje 'dis mdzad pas rnam 'grel gyi rnam bshad bsdus pa la rigs grub ces yod par de'i bsdus don yin nam snyam/las gzhi 'di'i ma dpe 'tshol bsdu dang dpe sgrig 'gan 'dzin karma bde legs/ rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gan khur ba mkhan po 'gro 'dul rdo rje/ ma dpe mkho 'don mdzad mkhan dpal gyi 'bras spungs chos sde/ chos sde chen po ngor e waṃ bshad grwa'i mkhan po thub bstan snying po/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe mdzod khang bcas dang*/ zhus dag thad rnam bshad rigs mdzod ni/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang dpe rtags ( phyi zha 32 ) nang bzhugs dang*/ sde dge'i spar ma/ sku 'bum spar ma bcas gsum las gtso bo 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs kyi dpe rnying la khungs bcol nas bzhag yod/

de las ches dpe rnying gi dbang gis tshig 'bru mi gsal ba dang*/ rtsa chad song rigs dang phrad sbyor stangs/ mngon gsal yig nor dag sde spar ltar bcos yod/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi bsdus don rigs pa'i sdom ni/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang dpe rtags ( phyi zha 6 ) nang bzhugs dang*/ sde spar gnyis las/ snga ma ni ches dpe rnying gi dbang gis tshig 'bru mi gsal ba dang*/ rtsa ba nas mi mthong ba kha shas 'dug pa dag /gtso bo sde spar la khungs gtugs yod/ rigs pa grub pa ni 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang dpe rtags ( phyi zha 31 ) nang bzhugs de las phrad sbyor stangs dang*/ mngon gsal yig nor kha shas brda sprod ltar dang*/ tshig 'bru mi gsal ba mi nyung ba tsam zhig kyang rang 'grel sogs rigs gter gyi 'grel pa mang po zhig la gtugs nas zhus yod/ zhu dag spyi'i brda gsar rnying sogs la grogs dan pa bstan 'dzin blo gros dang*/ rtsis 'khor nang blug mkhan dpal brtsegs las zhor slob ma rnams dang*/ deb sgrig pa shes rab dpal g.yang dang*/ tshe ring chos sgron gnyis kyis bgyis te grub pa zhig yin/ mjug tu ngas las gzhi 'di'i ma dpe 'tshol bsdu ba'i tshab zhus te/ gong gsal gyi dpe khag gsum g.yar gnang mdzad mkhan/ 'bras spungs chos sde/ ngor bshad grwa'i mkhan po thub bstan snying po dang*/ bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang gi las bzo ba yongs la thugs rje che zhu/ zhes dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas thub bstan nyi mas so/ / / / bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ PAGE -PAGE 3--PAGE 1-
